mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log(admin_id, target_table, target_pk, before_value, after_value, reason_code) VALUES(#{adminId}, #{targetTable}, #{targetPk}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{reasonCode})
mapper.select:
SELECT al.audit_id, al.admin_id, al.target_table, al.target_pk, al.before_value, al.after_value, al.reason_code, al.processed_at, au.name AS admin_name, au.role AS admin_role, target_admin.name AS target_admin_name, acc.account_no AS target_account_no FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN admin_user au ON au.admin_id = al.admin_id LEFT JOIN admin_user target_admin ON al.target_table = 'ADMIN_USER' AND target_admin.admin_id = CAST(al.target_pk AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN sell_order so ON al.target_table = 'SELL_ORDER' AND so.order_id = CAST(al.target_pk AS UNSIGNED) LEFT JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = so.account_id
ORDER BY al.processed_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
